meta.task: Design a battery for a next-generation pure electric sedan: energy density >= 392.61 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, overcharge to 4.7 V without triggering thermal runaway.
meta.base_rationale: Task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite baseline teaching parameterization); its 4.2 V upper cut-off + 0.5 V overcharge protocol lands exactly on the 4.7 V spec.
meta.freedoms_note: No degree of freedom declared in the task text -> widest interpretation per protocol (t1_r1 lesson: undeclared electrolyte adjustability must not be read as locked).

ablation.ceiling_escalation: ON (default, not mentioned in task text)
ablation.funnel_voting: ON (default, not mentioned in task text)

objective_breakdown: ED>=392.61 Wh/kg (contract stack-dry mass, electrolyte excluded) drives thick/low-porosity electrodes + thin collectors/separator; 4C no-plating and T_max<=333.15K (60C) at 45C ambient conflict with it (transport vs loading, heat vs mass); overcharge-to-4.7V-no-TR checked mechanically (cut-off 4.2V + 0.5V). Central trade-off: ED vs plating/T_max Pareto.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C SPMe->DFN, calc-energy, 4C lumped+plating, overcharge+run-tr); opening ceiling assessment with best-legal architecture + high-sigma electrolyte; if ceiling<392.61 escalate to Stage 2 material design (SiOx system switch OKane2022 / composition candidates; LNMO excluded: overcharge window mismatch with 4.7V spec); then free architecture exploration (exploration_force OFF) + full safety exam on every stage2-qualified candidate.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline; R2 ceiling probe; R3-R6 ED maximization (Chen2020 then escalated system); R7-R9 safety fine-tuning; closing deliverables/render (real_compute=false, no true compute).
risk_and_fallback: Chen2020 initial-state/thermal defaults: check initial-concentration keys; plating fallback: negative particle radius down, electrolyte sigma/t+ up, N/P up; T_max fallback: cooling h up; three-strike: question system/boundary/metric assumptions, plan-update + final escalation record.

detail: start_stage=3: no molecular screening; materials use system baseline parameters (props source=baseline literature parameterization). Base determination per anchor table: task text names no electrode system -> default Chen2020; verified by dumping the parameter set (pure-graphite negative, no SiOx keys; upper cut-off 4.2 V so overcharge +0.5 V = 4.7 V matches spec exactly). Ceiling assessment will be appended after baseline characterization.

candidates.role: high-transport electrolyte (sigma=1.8 S/m estimate of concentrated LiFSI/carbonate class, D=5e-10 estimate ~1.6x Nyman2008 baseline, t+=0.5 estimate) + liquid cold-plate cooling h=40 W/m2K

llm_reason: Round 1 shows the 4C charge terminating at 4.2 V after 0.18 Ah with anode potential -0.19 V and T_max 354.3 K dominated by the 45 C-ambient 1C discharge phase. Two single-dimension probes separate the rate-limiting causes: C1 = solid-diffusion (particle radius only), C2 = electrolyte transport + thermal rejection (sigma/t+/D/h only). Combining the surviving levers in R3 probes the architecture+formulation ceiling for 4C safety; ED baseline 400.75 Wh/kg already exceeds 392.61 so no ED-side escalation expected.

candidates.name: C3 submicron+transport+cooling
candidates.role: combined ceiling probe: single-crystal submicron cathode R=1 um (tau_solid=250 s < 900 s 4C window, commercial single-crystal NMC811 practice), anode R=2 um, high-transport electrolyte (sigma 1.8 S/m estimate, D 5e-10 estimate, t+ 0.5 estimate), pouch double-face liquid cold-plate cooling (A=2x0.1027=0.2054 m2 physical pouch geometry, h=25 W/m2K cold-plate practice)

llm_reason: R2 attribution: C2 transport+cooling fixed most of the charge-onset polarization but cathode solid diffusion (tau=6800 s baseline, 1560 s at 2.5 um) still blocks 4C charge (0.40 Ah); C1 alone worsened the onset anode dip via deeper discharge. C3 combines: submicron cathode (tau=250 s) + fine anode (tau=121 s) + C2 electrolyte + physical pouch cooling geometry (set value 0.00531 m2 is an edge-cooling artifact for a 0.1027 m2-electrode pouch; double-face cooling is the standard pack design). ED unaffected by these levers (mass geometry unchanged, ~401-416 Wh/kg, above 392.61). This combination probes the architecture+formulation ceiling for the 4C safety objective.

note: C3 performance: ED 425.44 Wh/kg (mass 0.04345 kg, 1C capacity 5.065 Ah, energy 18.49 Wh) - passes with 32.8 Wh/kg margin; no mass geometry changed from C2.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev, plated, triggered

candidates.name: C4 plating-margin
candidates.role: C3 + high-SOC plating margin: N/P 1.20->1.34 (anode 85.2->95 um, lowers anode x at 4C cutoff), anode R 1.5 um (activation surface +33%), cathode R 0.8 um single-crystal (tau=160 s, more CC headroom before 4.2 V cutoff)

llm_reason: C3 diagnosis: 4C experiment current is truly 20 A (trajectory self-consistent: 78% SOC at cutoff, OCV 3.94 V + ~0.2 V polarization = 4.15 V; runner capacity_ah under-reports charge by 5x - duration x C_rate/3600 without nominal capacity, true charge capacity = capacity_ah x 5 = 3.95 Ah). T_max 318.9 K pass, overcharge pass; only failure is the high-SOC anode dip -17.5 mV at end of charge. C4 targets that dip: N/P up (+~25 mV anode OCP at cutoff), anode R down (-~12 mV activation), cathode R 0.8 um for CC headroom. ED impact of 95 um anode ~ -3 Wh/kg, still above 392.61 (calc-energy will confirm).

detail: CEILING ASSESSMENT (R1-R4, exploration_force OFF, free exploration): start_stage=3 ceiling question - can electrode architecture + electrolyte formulation + thermal management levers alone meet ED>=392.61 Wh/kg, 4C no plating, T<=333.15 K, 4.7 V overcharge no TR? FINDINGS: (1) ED was never the binding constraint: 400.75 -> 416.07 -> 425.44 -> 456.26 Wh/kg; R4 discovery: Chen2020 is ANODE-limited (capacity tracks anode inventory 5.065->5.644 Ah with +11.5% anode thickness; capacity N/P ~0.91, correcting the R1-R3 assumption of 1.2) so anode thickening adds capacity+energy. (2) T_max solved by physical pouch double-face cooling: 354.29 -> 335.27 -> 318.90 K (criterion 333.15); the parameter-set cooling area 0.00531 m2 was an edge-cooling artifact for a 0.1027 m2 pouch. (3) Overcharge 4.7 V: triggered=false on every candidate (three-side-reaction ODE, T_max <= 298.52 K). (4) Single binding constraint = 4C no-plating, localized by attribution probes to the END-of-charge anode dip (onset dip solved in C3/C4; min -0.261 -> -1.87e-5 -> -0.0175 -> -0.0150 V). Physics: at 4C CC cutoff (4.2 V) the anode reaches x~0.73-0.77 where OCP+eta_a < 0; the finer cathode in C4 deepened the charge (78->81% SOC) and partially offset the N/P gain - a genuine tradeoff frontier between 4C CC acceptance depth and anode fullness. ESCALATION DECISION (ceiling_escalation ON, not triggered): the remaining ~15 mV lives inside Stage-3 reach - cathode/anode particle-size balance (cut CC depth to ~70% via R_pos 1.2 um, cut eta_a via R_neg 1.0 um); NO Stage-2 material-design fallback required. Next: R5 maps the acceptance-vs-plating frontier (C5 R_pos 1.2 um / C6 R_pos 1.1 um, both R_neg 1.0 um).
